text_block_list.text:
Адмайр Вега and I gather the courage
to tell
Мэйсё Дото the hard facts.
Without the
ambition to defeat T.M.
Opera O, her future is
bleak.

That also goes for Т.М. Опера О. If the
two don't
grow by competing against
each other, they'll
stand no chance
against the previous generation.

And it seems our words reach Meisho
Doto. Once
again, her unyielding
fighting spirit propels her
forward on her
journey.

With that, Мэйсё Дото decides to
announce her
rivalry with Т.М. Опера О
at the Japan Cup, for
both of their
sakes.
